name: ALICE
source:
Alice: Adventures in Wonderland is a rather frivolous adaptation of Lewis Carroll's classic tale. It is a text adventure with graphics; the player can interact with the environment by typing combinations of verbs and objects. Content-wise, the game features a few familiar characters and situations from the book, but many of them are completely new and involve not only story segments (such as a fight with a dragon) but also explicit erotic images such as naked pixies etc.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/alice-adventures-in-wonderland]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《爱丽丝梦游仙境》是对刘易斯·卡罗尔经典故事的一次颇为轻佻的改编。本作是一款带图像的文字冒险游戏，玩家可以输入由动词和宾语组成的指令，与环境互动。在内容方面，游戏虽然包含原著中的若干熟悉角色和情节，却也加入了大量全新内容，不仅有与巨龙作战等故事桥段，还有裸体小精灵等露骨的色情画面。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc88/alice-adventures-in-wonderland]MobyGames[/url]]
